description: Buyer discovery channels and verified company-level routes. Directory is NOT proof of partner acceptance or permission to scrape. contact routes refer to publicly advertised programme channels. No individual personal data.

routes.label: Semibold
routes.suggested_first_action: Send one enquiry to the published business address asking whether permission-based introductions from independently identified organisations are accepted; seek attribution approval before an introduction.
routes.expected_terms: Published 10% of eligible first website project fee; paid after completion and client invoice payment.

routes.label: Synmek
routes.suggested_first_action: Use the public partner registration form to obtain a referral code and verify whether this research-led sourcing model fits; obtain explicit confirmation before sharing prospects.
routes.expected_terms: Published 7%, 9%, 12% tiers, eligible first projects >=£2,000; published payout within 30 days of kickoff.

routes.label: Dispense Digital
routes.suggested_email_subject: Have I got news for you
routes.suggested_first_action: Ask whether independently sourced, consent-based introductions qualify: the website describes referrals by freelancers and other agencies with existing clients.
routes.expected_terms: Published 15% of qualifying monthly client revenue for lifetime of account.

routes.label: Circular Design
routes.suggested_first_action: Use the referrer registration form linked from the official page; clarify whether independently researched nonprofits qualify and when consent is required.
routes.expected_terms: Published fixed £200 for eligible website projects; page describes payment within 30 days of signed contract and three-month protection window.

discovery_surfaces.name: Web search: openly published paid referral programmes

discovery_surfaces.name: Find official company contact/partner page, not scraped personal inboxes
